title: Sharing the Taxi Fare
story: Three students reached the city station after dark with heavy backpacks. A taxi stood by the exit, but one ride looked expensive. Mina suggested they share the car and divide the fare. Hugo and Ade agreed, and Ade had the address on his phone. The driver nodded and put the bags in the back. On the way, Mina watched the street names to check the route. The hostel was a green building beside a quiet square. The square was empty, and the windows of the hostel were bright. The driver stopped at the door and told them the price. Hugo paid the full amount, and the others gave him their share in cash. They checked the receipt before the taxi left. Inside, the owner gave them keys and pointed to the stairs. Mina kept the receipt in her notebook. She wanted a clear record of what each person had paid.
